verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 remains sound. The generalized step-mapping reader preserves the existing fail-closed extraction behavior, while the new top-level scalar reader is bounded to the selected step and rejects duplicate keys. The seam assertion independently binds the consumer gate and GH_TOKEN expression to the named producer, then verifies that producer is the exact SHA-pinned App-token action with both secret inputs and the required sparq-org/sparq actions:write scope. Its synthetic fixtures exercise same-ID non-mints, altered scope, nesting, absence, first-key parsing, and duplicate refusal without turning expected misses into suite-aborting false kills. I found no blocker, major, or other diff-scoped correctness, test-validity, or security issue.
